Hegseth Could Still Be the Third Cabinet Secretary to be Impeached. What Happened to the Others?

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth narrowly escaped an impeachment attempt Tuesday after the Republican-led House rejected a resolution filed by a GOP lawmaker. While Hegseth has been granted a reprieve, it's possible the Democrats could revive the effort in January, when they take control of both the House and Senate following sweeping victories in the midterms.
